caseName: YRIBARNE v. COUNTY OF SAN BERNARDINO Et Al.
caseNameFull: John C. Yribarne v. County of San Bernardino Et A
attorneys: Herman F. Selvin for appellant. ., John N. Cramer for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
